```{r load_libraries, echo=FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(wrh.rUtils)
library(wrh.scRNA)
library(SingleR)
library(UCell)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(data.table)
library(glmGamPoi)
options(future.globals.maxSize= 891289600000)

### Local run
# baseDir_v <- "/Volumes/wrh_padlock3/projects/AP/novogene/"

### Exa run
baseDir_v <- "/home/exacloud/gscratch/CoussensLab/transcriptomic/novogene"
dataDir_v <- file.path(baseDir_v, "aligned")
rdsDir_v <- mkdir(baseDir_v, "rds")
qcDir_v <- mkdir(baseDir_v, "QC")
refDir_v <- file.path(baseDir_v, "ref")
plotDir_v <- mkdir(baseDir_v, "plots/noSketch/smallerPC")

### Get files
allFiles_v <- list.files(rdsDir_v, pattern = "from")
tumorFiles_v <- grep("Tumor", allFiles_v, value = T)
bloodFiles_v <- grep("Blood", allFiles_v, value = T)

# Run Flags
minPC_v <- F
pcName_v <- ifelse(minPC_v, "minPC", "maxPC")

source("/home/exacloud/gscratch/CoussensLab/transcriptomic/novogene/scripts/novogene/ref/uCellGeneLists.R")
```

# Load

```{r, eval = F}
### only load this if already run the rest
subDir_v <- file.path(rdsDir_v, "subProcessed_minPC")
files_v <- list.files(subDir_v)

all_lslsobj <- list("Tumor" = lapply(files_v, function(x) readRDS(file.path(subDir_v, x))))
names(all_lslsobj$Tumor) <- gsub("fromTumor_|\\.rds", "", files_v)
```

# UCell Scores

## Lymphoid

```{r}
all_lslsobj$Tumor$lymphoid <- AddModuleScore_UCell(all_lslsobj$Tumor$lymphoid,
                                                   features = uCellLymphoidMarkers_lsv)

# grab the score columns (UCell appends "_UCell" to each set name)
score_cols <- paste0(names(uCellLymphoidMarkers_lsv), "_UCell")

# per-cluster mean scores
lymphoidScores_dt <- as.data.table(all_lslsobj$Tumor$lymphoid@meta.data)[, c("seurat_clusters", score_cols), with = FALSE]
avgLymphoidScores_dt <- lymphoidScores_dt[, lapply(.SD, mean), by = seurat_clusters]
setorder(avgLymphoidScores_dt, seurat_clusters)
avgLymphoidScores_mat <- as.matrix(convertDFT(avgLymphoidScores_dt, col_v = "seurat_clusters"))

colnames(avgLymphoidScores_mat) <- gsub("_UCell", "", colnames(avgLymphoidScores_mat))

pheatmap::pheatmap(t(avgLymphoidScores_mat), scale = "column", clustering_method = "ward.D2",
                   cluster_cols = F, cluster_rows = F, main = "Scale Column - Cluster's Top Population",
                   angle_col = 0)
pheatmap::pheatmap(t(avgLymphoidScores_mat), scale = "row", clustering_method = "ward.D2",
                   cluster_cols = F, cluster_rows = F, main = "Scale row - Population's Top Cluster(s)",
                   angle_col = 0)

pdf(file = file.path(plotDir_v, "lymphohidUCellHeatmap.pdf"), height = 4, width = 5)
pheatmap::pheatmap(t(avgLymphoidScores_mat), scale = "column", clustering_method = "ward.D2",
                   cluster_cols = F, cluster_rows = F, main = "Scale Column - Cluster's Top Population",
                   angle_col = 0)
pheatmap::pheatmap(t(avgLymphoidScores_mat), scale = "row", clustering_method = "ward.D2",
                   cluster_cols = F, cluster_rows = F, main = "Scale row - Population's Top Cluster(s)",
                   angle_col = 0)
dev.off()
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=30}
lymphoidMelt_dt <- melt(lymphoidScores_dt, id.vars = "seurat_clusters")

ggplot(lymphoidMelt_dt, aes(x = seurat_clusters, y = value)) + geom_violin() + 
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free", ncol= 5)

ggplot(lymphoidMelt_dt, aes(x = variable, y = value)) + geom_violin() + 
  facet_wrap(~seurat_clusters, scales = "free", ncol= 1)
```

# Myeloid

```{r}
all_lslsobj$Tumor$myeloid <- AddModuleScore_UCell(all_lslsobj$Tumor$myeloid,
                                                   features = uCellMyeloidMarkers_lsv)

# grab the score columns (UCell appends "_UCell" to each set name)
score_cols <- paste0(names(uCellMyeloidMarkers_lsv), "_UCell")

# per-cluster mean scores
myeloidScores_dt <- as.data.table(all_lslsobj$Tumor$myeloid@meta.data)[, c("seurat_clusters", score_cols), with = FALSE]
avgMyeloidScores_dt <- myeloidScores_dt[, lapply(.SD, mean), by = seurat_clusters]
setorder(avgMyeloidScores_dt, seurat_clusters)
avgMyeloidScores_mat <- as.matrix(convertDFT(avgMyeloidScores_dt, col_v = "seurat_clusters"))

colnames(avgMyeloidScores_mat) <- gsub("_UCell", "", colnames(avgMyeloidScores_mat))

pheatmap::pheatmap(t(avgMyeloidScores_mat), scale = "column", clustering_method = "ward.D2",
                   cluster_cols = F, cluster_rows = F, main = "Scale Column - Cluster's Top Population",
                   angle_col = 0)
pheatmap::pheatmap(t(avgMyeloidScores_mat), scale = "row", clustering_method = "ward.D2",
                   cluster_cols = F, cluster_rows = F, main = "Scale row - Population's Top Cluster(s)",
                   angle_col = 0)

pdf(file = file.path(plotDir_v, "myeloidUCellHeatmap.pdf"), height = 4, width = 5)
pheatmap::pheatmap(t(avgMyeloidScores_mat), scale = "column", clustering_method = "ward.D2",
                   cluster_cols = F, cluster_rows = F, main = "Scale Column - Cluster's Top Population",
                   angle_col = 0)
pheatmap::pheatmap(t(avgMyeloidScores_mat), scale = "row", clustering_method = "ward.D2",
                   cluster_cols = F, cluster_rows = F, main = "Scale row - Population's Top Cluster(s)",
                   angle_col = 0)
dev.off()
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=30}
myeloidMelt_dt <- melt(myeloidScores_dt, id.vars = "seurat_clusters")
ggplot(myeloidMelt_dt, aes(x = seurat_clusters, y = value)) + geom_violin() + facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free", ncol= 5)
ggplot(myeloidMelt_dt, aes(x = variable, y = value)) + geom_violin() + facet_wrap(~seurat_clusters, scales = "free", ncol= 1)
```

# Feature Plots

## Lymphoid

```{r}
lymphoidFeatDir_v <- mkdir(plotDir_v, "tumorLymphoidFeatures")
for (i in 1:length(uniqueLymphoidMarkers_lsv)) {
  
  currPopName_v <- names(uniqueLymphoidMarkers_lsv)[i]
  currGenes_v <- uniqueLymphoidMarkers_lsv[[currPopName_v]]
  currGenes_v <- intersect(currGenes_v, rownames(all_lslsobj$Tumor$lymphoid))
  
  if (length(currGenes_v) < 5) {
    currH_v <- 12; currW_v <- 12
  } else {
    currH_v <- 12; currW_v <- 20
  }
  
  currFeat_lsgg <- lapply(currGenes_v, function(x) {
    y <- FeaturePlot(all_lslsobj$Tumor$lymphoid, features = x) + theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16))
    return(y)})
  currFeat_gg <- ggpubr::ggarrange(plotlist = currFeat_lsgg)
  currFeat_gg <- ggpubr::annotate_figure(currFeat_gg, top = text_grob(label = currPopName_v, size = 16))
  
  pdf(file = file.path(lymphoidFeatDir_v, paste0(currPopName_v, "_feat.pdf")), width = currW_v, height = currH_v)
  print(currFeat_gg)
  dev.off()
}
```

## Myeloid

```{r}
myeloidFeatDir_v <- mkdir(plotDir_v, "tumorMyeloidFeatures")
for (i in 1:length(uniqueMyeloidMarkers_lsv)) {
  
  currPopName_v <- names(uniqueMyeloidMarkers_lsv)[i]
  currGenes_v <- uniqueMyeloidMarkers_lsv[[currPopName_v]]
  currGenes_v <- intersect(currGenes_v, rownames(all_lslsobj$Tumor$myeloid))
  
  if (length(currGenes_v) == 1) {
    currH_v <- 6; currW_v <- 6
  } else if (length(currGenes_v) == 2) {
    currH_v <- 6; currW_v <- 12
  } else if (length(currGenes_v) %in% 3:4) {
    currH_v <- 12; currW_v <- 12
  } else if (length(currGenes_v) %in% 5:6) {
    currH_v <- 12; currW_v <- 20
  } else {
    currH_v <- 18; currW_v <- 20
  }
  
  currFeat_lsgg <- lapply(currGenes_v, function(x) {
    y <- FeaturePlot(all_lslsobj$Tumor$myeloid, features = x) + theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16))
    return(y)})
  currFeat_gg <- ggpubr::ggarrange(plotlist = currFeat_lsgg)
  currFeat_gg <- ggpubr::annotate_figure(currFeat_gg, top = text_grob(label = currPopName_v, size = 16))
  
  pdf(file = file.path(myeloidFeatDir_v, paste0(currPopName_v, "_feat.pdf")), width = currW_v, height = currH_v)
  print(currFeat_gg)
  dev.off()
}
```

```{r}
for (i in 1:length(customFeats_lslsv)) {
  
  currPop_v <- names(customFeats_lslsv)[i]
  currObj <- all_lslsobj$Tumor[[currPop_v]]
  currList_lsv <- customFeats_lslsv[[currPop_v]]
  
  for (j in 1:length(currList_lsv)) {
    
    ### Get genes
    currGroupName_v <- names(currList_lsv)[j]
    currGenes_v <- intersect(currList_lsv[[currGroupName_v]], rownames(currObj))
    
    ### Determine plot size
    if (length(currGenes_v) <= 4) {
      currH_v <- 12; currW_v <- 12
    } else if (length(currGenes_v) == 6) {
      currH_v <- 18; currW_v <- 12
    } else if (length(currGenes_v) %in% 11:12) {
      currH_v <- 18; currW_v <- 24
    } else if (length(currGenes_v) %in% 16:18) {
      currH_v <- 24; currW_v <- 24
    } else {
      currH_v <- 42; currW_v <- 24
    }
    
    ### Make plot
    currFeat_gg <- FeaturePlot(currObj, features = currGenes_v)
    
    pdf(file = file.path(myeloidFeatDir_v, paste0(currPopName_v, "_feat.pdf")), width = currW_v, height = currH_v)
    print(currFeat_gg)
    dev.off()
    
  } # for j
} # for i

```

# Write out

```{r}
newRdsDir_v <- mkdir(rdsDir_v, "subProcessed_minPC")
sapply(names(all_lslsobj), function(x) {
  sapply(names(all_lslsobj[[x]]), function(y) {
    saveRDS(all_lslsobj[[x]][[y]], file = file.path(newRdsDir_v, paste0("from", x, "_", y, "_UCell.rds")))
  })
})
```
